lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₂In₈Mo₄S₂₀ (reduced formula MgIn₄(MoS₅)₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 34 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Mo each adopt octahedral coordination by six S neighbors, while In centers have four S neighbors. Sulfur centers exhibit two distinct environments: an octahedral motif with one In and five S neighbors, and a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve neighbors. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Mg and Mo octahedra, corner-sharing between In and S polyhedra, and face-sharing between In and Mg, In and Mo, and S-centered polyhedra.
